item.title: US naval blockade of Strait of Hormuz to begin; Israel braces for possible Iran surprise attack
item.description: Netanyahu says Israel is fully coordinated with the US as ministers prepare for renewed fighting; Pakistan claims new US-Iran talks may resume soon despite tensions

item.title: Israel prepares for US blockade, warns of risk of Iran surprise attack
item.description: Netanyahu says Iran breached ceasefire terms by not reopening the strait, backing US action and stressing close coordination with Washington on stopping enrichment and countering threats

item.title: Vance: 'We did not reach an agreement, are returning to US'; Israel preparing to attack energy facilities
item.description: In the shadow of a 'deadlock' on the Strait of Hormuz issue, US vice president announced at end of three rounds of talks in Pakistan: 'We were quite flexible, Iran did not accept our conditions'; Tehran accuses: 'Excessive and illegal demands'

item.title: Survey: most Israelis oppose Iran ceasefire, divided on whether to respect it
item.description: Hebrew U poll finds support for Netanyahu has declined since the war began, with 34% backing him now compared to 40% at the start of the conflict

item.title: Trump’s ‘chess game’ and Israel’s preparations: ‘The goal is strong pressure on Iran’
item.description: The US president signals readiness to resume fighting as Iran issues threats, but Israel expects the ceasefire to hold and aims to push Tehran back to more realistic talks; Netanyahu’s cabinet to review scenarios and a possible Trump visit

item.title: המצור הימי יחל ב-17:00, בישראל נערכים גם למתקפת פתע. נתניהו: מתואמים עם ארה"ב

item.description: עוד לפני מבצע "שאגת הארי", נולד בישראל אקוסיסטם של מפות והתרעות שמרכז בזמן אמת נתוני שיגורים, יירוטים ושיבושי GPS. יוזמות עצמאיות ואתרי חדשות מציגים לציבור מידע שבעבר היה שמור לחמ"לים צבאיים בלבד. בעולם של איומים מתמשכים, הדאטה הפך לכלי הישרדות של ממש

item.title: Direct hit in Nahariya, non-stop sirens in northern Israel; IDF says 250 Hezbollah terrorists killed
item.description: Sirens continue across Israel’s north after direct strike on Nahariya; IDF reports major Lebanon operation 'Eternal Darkness' killed over 250 Hezbollah operatives, including senior commanders, with search and alerts ongoing

item.title: IDF completes encirclement of Hezbollah stronghold Bint Jbeil, launches assault on town | Watch
item.description: More than 100 Hezbollah terrorists killed as troops destroy infrastructure and uncover weapons, as diplomatic talks between Israel and Lebanon are set to begin in Washington

item.title: Netanyahu in Lebanon: 'The war continues, there is more work to do'
item.description: PM says operations continue inside the security zone to push back infiltration, anti-tank missile fire and rocket threats, as Israel says more work remains despite major gains
